review_state: assembly position localized; owner two-hole geometric candidate; rails unproved
source_context: The .009 assembly draws a horizontal C97 body on the E5 line immediately above and right of D30, beyond the vertical R6/R5 pair. Sheet-1 puts C97 in the C94-C98 +5 V-to-ground bypass group.
refdes_disambiguation: The vertical pair beside D30 reads R6 (left) and R5 (right) in the original 114604420 assembly image. A separate vertical pair left of D1 reads R37/R36; those resistors are elsewhere on the same sheet and must not be used as C97 local registration anchors.

owner_candidate_holes.observation: open annulus on a narrow vertical front-copper trace, above/right of the R6/R5 pair
upper open annulus on a wider plated vertical strip farther right; a white factory wire passes just below it

overlap_cross_check: The independent overlapping owner photograph 200439607 shows both open annuli above the same wire bundle. Their two-photo displacements are (-222,+393) and (-223,+392) px. D13 package anchors in the same photos give about (-220,+415) px; the 22 px y difference over the intervening area cautions against a single global translation. The pairwise agreement confirms two distinct visible holes and no fitted capacitor body at either, but it does not identify their nets or prove that they are C97 terminals.
decision: The two holes are a geometric C97 landing hypothesis, not a proved capacitor footprint. Their visible x separation fits the assembly body relative to R6/R5, but the y offset and intervening wire bundle prevent a unique assignment. Do not infer +5 V or ground from strip width, and do not assign a DNP status from the absence of a body in this single crop.
solder_cross_check: The former D13-based solder estimates (3336,1566) and (3591,1511) used a now-retired D13 fit that mixed a D13 row with a D105 row. They are withdrawn. Even with the corrected D13 field, C97 lies far outside its package anchors, so no opposite-face C97 hole is promoted from that extrapolation.
local_reference_limit: At original resolution in component 200450127, the upper R6 lead is crossed by the white cable bundle; R5's lower lead bends left from the resistor body before reaching its annulus. Body-centre coordinates are therefore not safe substitutes for plated-hole centres in a front-to-back registration. The candidate solder region in 200537608 contains several multi-joint vertical strips, so matching either resistor by apparent body x position alone is ambiguous.

d30_two_face_recheck.method: Reflected affine fit of the registered D30 pins 1,7,8,11,14 in local-package-registration.json. Their photo centers form regular rows, so the fit has near-zero residual by construction; independent D13 upper-row pins in the same two photos land within about 4 px, while D13's farther lower row drifts by about 15 px.
d30_two_face_recheck.observation: The first prediction falls on a narrow horizontal trace without a visible drill; an open hole around (2434,399) is roughly 42 px away. The second prediction falls beside a wide strip without a visible drill; a visible open hole around (2192,460) is roughly 56 px away. Those offsets greatly exceed the local D30/D13 contact agreement, but C97 lies outside the D30 package-anchor span, so neither nearby hole can be declared a counterpart or absolutely excluded by this extrapolation.
d30_two_face_recheck.decision: Keep both component holes as distinct C97 search candidates. Do not assign either neighboring solder hole or its net by proximity. A local resistor/annulus landmark or direct continuity is needed for exact front-to-back identity.

d30_d13_projective_recheck.method: Independent eight-parameter projective fit of ten registered package-contact pairs spanning D30 pins 1,7,8,11,14 and D13 pins 1,4,7,8,14 in component 200439607 and solder 200537608. Neither C97 feature or resistor body enters the fit.
d30_d13_projective_recheck.package_contact_residual_px: About 0.8–3.0 px across the ten contacts; a single affine fit of the same contacts has about 1.9–3.5 px residual.
d30_d13_projective_recheck.observation: Both projective predictions again lie on solder areas without distinct drilled centers in native crop (1970,260)-(2530,590). The nearest conspicuous holes at approximately (2434,399)/(2192,460) are now about 52/70 px away. The D30-only affine predicts (2393,390)/(2137,450), within 10/14 px of the projective predictions, so choice of these two package fits does not explain the large nearest-hole offsets.
d30_d13_projective_recheck.limit: Both C97 candidates lie to the right of the calibrated package-contact envelope, particularly the second. The fits exclude adopting the nearby solder holes by simple geometric snap but cannot prove where either front hole exits on the back face; use direct continuity or a closer uniquely identified drilled landmark.

next_inspection: With power off, meter front holes (1690,524)/(1926,580) in 200450127, repeated at (1468,917)/(1703,972) in 200439607, separately to known +5 V and ground. Find exact back-side counterparts from a nearby independently matched R6/R5 drilled hole or by continuity; do not adopt solder (2434,399)/(2192,460) solely from the D30 extrapolation. Check neighboring annuli on the wide strip individually before identifying a C97 pad pair.
